text.jp:
私がフォドラを出てこの地に踏み込んでから、
実はすでに５年ほどの歳月が経過しています。
text.official_en:
It has been roughly five years since I first left
Fódlan and set foot upon this land.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……まあ、貴方と出会うまでは満足な
成果も上げられていなかったわけですが。
text.official_en:
I must admit that, until I met you, I had
accomplished little in my wanderings.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
彼の地は、自分にとって執着や思い入れなど
何もない場所だと考えていましたが、
text.official_en:
Though I thought I had little attachment to
that place...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今は不思議と、懐かしさのようなものが
この胸の奥に沸き起こっているのを感じます。
text.official_en:
oddly I now feel a strange feeling of fondness for it
welling up in my breast.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
………………むむ？
馬鹿な、この私に郷愁などという感情が！？
text.official_en: *sigh* That I would feel this? Ridiculous!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
むむむむむ……――いい！
この胸を緩く締め付けられる感じ、実にいい！
text.official_en:
Grrr... Yes! This gently constrictive sensation in my
chest! It is truly wonderful!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
バアル湖って、でっかくて海みたいに
見えるけど実際は淡水の湖じゃない？
text.official_en:
Lake Baal spreads out like the sea, but it's actually
a freshwater lake, right?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そのせいなのかな。ダグシオンに並んでる
魚って、なんとなく臭くってさ。
text.official_en:
I wonder if that's why all the fish they catch in
Dagsion smell strange.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
やっぱりあたいは、フィーナの沖で穫れる
海の魚の味が一番だなって思ってたんだ。
text.official_en:
Truth is, the fish you can catch off the coast of Fina
really do taste the best.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だから……最近はちょっとだけ、
村に居た頃が懐かしいかな。平気だけどさ。
text.official_en:
*sigh* Think that just means I'm starting to miss
Fina. A little bit. But I'm OK.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
しかし……アラゴの双璧なんて連中が、
どうしてこんな所に出てくるんだろうね。
text.official_en:
I wonder why the Twin Jewels of Arago showed up
in Dagsion...
text.real_en:
I wonder why Arago's Twin Pillars showed up
in Dagsion...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ディートリヒ、あんたまさか、アラゴ王の
恨みを買うことでもやらかしたのかい？
text.official_en:
Dietrich, did you do something to incur the wrath of
the king of Arago?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それとも……まさか、
狙われているのは、あたし……？
text.official_en: Wait...it's me they're after. No! It can't be... Can it?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
確かにあの鉱山から脱出する時に大暴れは
したけど……いや、さすがにそこまでは……
text.official_en:
Sure, I did what I had to. I had to escape that mine!
But this...this is excessive!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク

text.jp:
……まったく、我らの
麗しき宰相殿にも困ったものだ。
text.official_en:
Things are getting out of hand. So much so that our
lovely chancellor might lose her grip on them.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが……なぜあの神官どのをそれほど
貶めねばならんのか、実に興味が尽きぬ。
text.official_en:
I wonder what she has against that priest in the
cat mask.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees
Event performs a motion command on the same person

text.jp:
――待て、キリーク。
人が見ている。
text.official_en: Hold, Creek. We're not alone.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……俺たちは今、取り込み中だ。
用があるなら、すまないが後に――
text.official_en:
Sorry, but we're busy, friend. If you have business,
come back later.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees
Event performs a motion command on the same person

text.jp:
おい見ろ、ネイサン。この男、
最近噂になっている、例の黒い剣士だぞ。
text.official_en:
Don't be so hasty, Nathan. This is the swordsman in
black—the talk of the town.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
海を越えてこの地に来た、
異形の剣の使い手という噂だが。
text.official_en:
See that grotesque sword? Rumor has it he crossed
the seas to reach this land.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees
Event stages a different sole actor; audited counterexample class shows staging actor is the listener and ATR1.PID remains the speaker

text.jp:
ほう……？　では、ラミーヌ一家の
ディートリヒというのはお前か。
text.official_en: Dietrich of House Lamine, is it?
text.real_en: Dietrich of the Lamine Family, is it?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees
Event performs a motion command on the same person

text.jp:
次の試合は我々とだったな。
お前との手合わせ、楽しみにしておこう。
text.official_en:
You're our next opponent, then. I look forward to
our fight.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
どうやら、次の対戦相手は、
この地ではなかなかの有名人のようだな。
text.official_en:
Your next foes seem to be quite celebrated
across this land.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……君の手並み、しっかりと
拝見させてもらうことにしよう。
text.official_en: I'll be observing what you can do.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あ、あの……次の試合、
すごく有名な人達が相手みたいですね。
text.official_en: It seems your next opponents are very well-known...

text.jp:
わたし、マーズ様の神殿にお参りして、
あなたの勝利を祈っておきます。
text.official_en:
I will visit the temple of Mars and pray for
your victory!
text.real_en: I'll visit Mars-sama's temple and pray for your victory.

text.jp:
はい、これ。
受け取ってください……
text.official_en: For now, there is this. Please take it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
まさか、あのアラゴの双璧の戦いを
この目で見られるなんて思わなかったよ。
text.official_en:
Never thought I'd witness the Twin Jewels of Arago
fight with my own two eyes!
text.real_en:
Never thought I'd witness Arago's Twin Pillars
fight with my own two eyes!

text.jp:
次の試合は、仕事を休んででも
絶対に見に行かないと……！
text.official_en:
I don't care if I have to beg off work—I've got to see
this next match!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
アラゴの双璧って知ってる？
とっても強い騎士で、ボクの憧れなんだ！
text.official_en:
Twin Jewels of Arago... You've heard of them, right?
They're the bravest and strongest knights EVER!
text.real_en:
Arago's Twin Pillars... You've heard of them, right?
They're the bravest and strongest knights EVER!

text.jp:
赤騎士ネイサンはすごい力持ちで、
馬だって担ぎ上げちゃうらしいし、
text.official_en:
Nathan, the Catoblepas, is strong enough to lift
a horse!

text.jp:
緑騎士キリークは豹みたいに素早いうえに、
頭だって抜群にいいんだぞ！
text.official_en:
Creek, the Pantere, is as swift as a leopard and
smarter than, well, anybody!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ネイサン様にキリーク様……
ああ……どちらもとっても素敵だわ。
text.official_en: Nathan...and Creek... So wonderful.
text.real_en: Nathan-sama and Creek-sama... Ah... They're both so wonderful.

text.jp:
ほら、アラゴ王国の王様とお后様も
来賓として招かれているじゃない？
text.official_en:
Perhaps you've heard that the king and queen of
Arago are to be guests of honor at the next match.

text.jp:
アラゴの双璧のお二人は、その護衛として
一緒にダグシオンに来ていたみたいなの！
text.official_en:
The Twin Jewels accompanied them to Dagsion as
their bodyguards!
